source3D.geometry: Unmodified PubChem source conformer; no local minimization or optimizer-convergence claim.

normalization.expandedHPolicy: Free orthogonal axes at each saturated carbon, matching the existing eight school-form alkanes; parent horizontal.
normalization.skeletalQuaternaryPolicy: For a degree-four parent center with two off-parent sides, rotate complete sides to exterior bisector +/-30 degrees; preserve 120-degree parent zigzag, all lengths and other local angles. No molecule-ID exception.

atomCorrespondence.heavy2DAcrossForms: Carbon IDs 1..N are identical in all three 2D forms.
atomCorrespondence.hydrogenEquivalence: Explicit H are bijectively matched by bonded carbon; symmetry-equivalent H order is arbitrary. These constitutionally achiral alkanes encode no stereochemistry.

validation.achiralityMethod: Rooted-tree substituent equality at each tetrahedral carbon, including explicit H.
